camel_example: aliyun servicemesh ListWaypoints --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --ClusterId ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000
description_en: Retrieves all Waypoint configurations in a namespace of a data plane cluster
description_zh: 调用ListWaypoints获取数据面集群某个命名空间下所有Waypoint配置
kebab_example: aliyun servicemesh list-waypoints --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --cluster-id ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWaypoints

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data plane cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the waypoint. If this parameter is left empty, all waypoints are returned. Otherwise, only the waypoint with the specified name is returned
parameters.help_zh: waypoint名称。为空时，返回所有waypoint；不为空时，查询指定名称waypoint
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of waypoints to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: A pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. For the first call, leave this parameter empty. If the response includes a Continue value, more results are available. To get the next page, include the returned Continue value in your next request
parameters.help_zh: 配合Limit使用，用于从指定offset开始查询waypoint。第一次调用时，填写空即可。如果返回结果中Continue不为空，即代表还有未返回的数据，需要带上返回的Continue继续调用
parameters.name: continue

Continue.description_en: A Base64-encoded string. If this parameter is empty, all waypoints have been returned. If this parameter is not empty, include it in your next request to retrieve the next page of results
Continue.description_zh: base64编码的字符串。如果为空，表示已经获取到所有的waypoint；如果不为空，下次list时带上该值，可以接着从本次截止的offset继续获取

HPAEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) is enabled

HPAMaxReplicas.description_en: The maximum number of replicas for HPA

HPAMinReplicas.description_en: The minimum number of replicas for HPA

HPATargetCPU.description_en: The target CPU utilization for HPA

HPATargetMemory.description_en: The target memory usage for HPA

LimitCPU.description_en: The CPU resource limit for the Waypoint pod

LimitMemory.description_en: The memory resource limit for the Waypoint pod

Name.description_en: The name of the Gateway resource for the Waypoint. If the Waypoint applies to a service account, this value is the same as the service account name. If the Waypoint applies to a namespace, the name is `namespace`
Name.description_zh: Waypoint对应的Gateway资源名称。如果ServiceAccount 生效，则与ServiceAccount同名；如果命名空间生效，则名称为 `namespace`

PreferECI.description_en: Indicates whether the Waypoint is preferentially scheduled to Elastic Container Instance (ECI) nodes

Replicas.description_en: The number of replicas for the Waypoint pod

RequestCPU.description_en: The CPU resources requested for the Waypoint pod

RequestMemory.description_en: The memory resources requested for the Waypoint pod

ServiceAccount.description_en: The service account for which the Waypoint is effective. If this parameter is empty, the Waypoint applies to the entire namespace
ServiceAccount.description_zh: Waypoint生效的ServiceAccount。如果为空，表示对整个命名空间生效
